newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic, NYNEX offer program for disabled.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic, NYNEX offer program for disabled.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp and NYNEX Corp Monday announced a program to make their services and products more accessible to people with disabilities.
The companies pledged that when they merge they will:
-- Adopt universal design principles to ensure that all company-wide telecommunications services are fully accessible and widely marketed to a broad range of users.
-- Include persons with disabilities on consumer panels and advisory committees.
-- Use advertising that is accessible to consumers who have hearing or visual disabilities.
-- Expand the existing line of Bell Atlantic and NYNEX products and services that are already accessible and usable by people with disabilities.
